customer_concentration.grouping_method: Used economic customer level defined as COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id). Parent roll-up available in dim_customer but mostly null; consolidation applied where present.

retention.methodology: Monthly ARR history from fact_subscription_month was aggregated to economic customer level using COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id). NRR and GRR used the January 2025 positive-ARR starting cohort. Monthly movement analysis preserved churn and later reactivation events. Reported GRR excludes expansion and excludes reactivation benefit; a separate SQL test quantified GRR including reactivation at 97.3652% for methodology comparison. Logo churn is reported as gross churn events during FY2025, defined as starting-cohort customers with at least one transition to zero ARR during February-December 2025, even if later reactivated.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management-tagged recurring revenue used fact_invoice_line.revenue_type values containing recurring/subscription. Independently restated recurring revenue required both product evidence and service-period evidence: delivery_model or product_family indicating subscription/recurring economics plus non-null service_period_start and service_period_end. Rows failing the independent support test were not treated as independently supported recurring revenue.

collections_quality.weighted_collection_days_methodology: Calculated as sum(amount_paid_usd * days_outstanding) / sum(amount_paid_usd) for FY2025 invoices with non-null payment_date and amount_paid_usd. This is a paid-invoice value-weighted collection timing metric and is not labeled traditional DSO because period-end AR balance data is not separately available.

customer_tenure.population: Top 10 economic customers ranked by FY2025 revenue

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
Revenue grew at a 14% CAGR over FY2023-FY2025.
Top 10 customers have an average tenure of 6 years.

metric_evidence.methodology: Validated physical objects and columns from the active schema before building metric queries.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT MIN(dt) AS start_date, MAX(dt) AS end_date, COUNT(DISTINCT yr) AS periods_available_count FROM ( SELECT invoice_date AS dt, YEAR(invoice_date) AS yr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice UNION ALL SELECT snapshot_month AS dt, YEAR(snapshot_month) AS yr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month ) x
metric_evidence.methodology: Determined overall structured-data coverage across invoicing and monthly ARR tables.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_year AS ( SELECT YEAR(fi.invoice_date) AS fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(fil.line_amount_usd),2) AS total_revenue_usd, COUNT(*) AS revenue_line_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id GROUP BY YEAR(fi.invoice_date) ) SELECT * FROM revenue_year ORDER BY fiscal_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Used invoice-line grain joined to invoice header for invoice_date, avoiding invoice-header duplication.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_year AS ( SELECT YEAR(fi.invoice_date) AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id GROUP BY YEAR(fi.invoice_date) ), calc AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN revenue_usd END) AS start_revenue, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN revenue_usd END) AS end_revenue, 2 AS num_years FROM revenue_year ) SELECT start_revenue, end_revenue, num_years, ROUND((POWER(end_revenue / start_revenue, 1.0 / num_years) - 1) * 100, 4) AS revenue_cagr_pct FROM calc
metric_evidence.methodology: Calculated CAGR fully in SQL from FY2023 to FY2025 revenue.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_2025 AS ( SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, MAX(dc.customer_name) AS sample_customer_name, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id) ), ranked AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, sample_customer_name, revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, economic_customer_id) AS rn, SUM(revenue_usd) OVER () AS total_revenue_usd FROM revenue_2025 ) SELECT MAX(total_revenue_usd) AS total_revenue_usd, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue_usd) * 100, 4) AS top_1_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 3 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue_usd) * 100, 4) AS top_3_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 5 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue_usd) * 100, 4) AS top_5_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total_revenue_usd) * 100, 4) AS top_10_pct FROM ranked
metric_evidence.methodology: Computed FY2025 concentration at economic customer level using customer parent roll-up where available.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_2025 AS ( SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, MAX(dc.customer_name) AS customer_name, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id) ) SELECT economic_customer_id, customer_name, ROUND(revenue_usd,2) AS revenue_usd FROM revenue_2025 ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, economic_customer_id LIMIT 10
metric_evidence.methodology: Provided the leading FY2025 economic customers contributing to concentration metrics.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, fsm.snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fsm.customer_id = dc.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id), fsm.snapshot_month ), hist AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd,1,0) OVER (PARTITION BY economic_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr_usd, MAX(CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY economic_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS had_positive_before FROM monthly ), classified AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, prev_arr_usd, COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) AS had_positive_before, CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 AND prev_arr_usd = 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 0 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS new_logo_arr, CASE WHEN arr_usd > prev_arr_usd AND prev_arr_usd > 0 THEN arr_usd - prev_arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS expansion_arr, CASE WHEN arr_usd < prev_arr_usd AND arr_usd > 0 THEN prev_arr_usd - arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS contraction_arr, CASE WHEN arr_usd = 0 AND prev_arr_usd > 0 THEN prev_arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS churned_arr, CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 AND prev_arr_usd = 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 1 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS reactivation_arr FROM hist ), period_bridge AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE '2025-01-01' THEN beginning_arr END) AS beginning_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' THEN new_logo_arr ELSE 0 END) AS new_logo_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' THEN expansion_arr ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' THEN contraction_arr ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' THEN churned_arr ELSE 0 END) AS churned_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' THEN reactivation_arr ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE '2025-12-01' THEN ending_arr END) AS ending_arr FROM ( SELECT snapshot_month, SUM(arr_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY snapshot_month) AS ending_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE '2025-01-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS beginning_arr, new_logo_arr, expansion_arr, contraction_arr, churned_arr, reactivation_arr FROM classified ) x ), dedup AS ( SELECT DISTINCT beginning_arr, new_logo_arr, expansion_arr, contraction_arr, churned_arr, reactivation_arr, ending_arr FROM period_bridge ) SELECT *, ROUND(beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr + reactivation_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr,2) AS reconciled_ending_arr, ROUND(ending_arr - (beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr + reactivation_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr),2) AS reconciliation_diff FROM dedup
metric_evidence.methodology: Built FY2025 ARR bridge from full monthly customer ARR history, distinguishing new logos from reactivations using prior positive ARR history and testing bridge reconciliation in SQL.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, fsm.snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fsm.customer_id = dc.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id), fsm.snapshot_month ), jan AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, arr_usd AS start_arr FROM monthly WHERE snapshot_month = DATE '2025-01-01' AND arr_usd > 0 ), month_progress AS ( SELECT j.economic_customer_id, m.snapshot_month, COALESCE(m.arr_usd,0) AS arr_usd, j.start_arr FROM jan j LEFT JOIN monthly m ON j.economic_customer_id = m.economic_customer_id AND m.snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' ), summary AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, MAX(start_arr) AS start_arr, MIN(CASE WHEN snapshot_month >= DATE '2025-02-01' AND arr_usd = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dummy, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month >= DATE '2025-02-01' AND arr_usd = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_zero_during_period, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE '2025-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE NULL END) AS end_arr, MIN(COALESCE(arr_usd,0)) AS min_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month >= DATE '2025-02-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS max_in_period FROM month_progress GROUP BY economic_customer_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS starting_logo_count, SUM(CASE WHEN had_zero_during_period = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_logo_count_gross_events, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN had_zero_during_period = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 4) AS logo_churn_pct_gross, ROUND(SUM(end_arr) / SUM(start_arr) * 100, 4) AS nrr_pct_simple, ROUND(SUM(LEAST(end_arr, start_arr)) / SUM(start_arr) * 100, 4) AS grr_pct_simple FROM summary
metric_evidence.methodology: Calculated gross logo churn for the January 2025 starting cohort based on any churn event during FY2025.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, fsm.snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fsm.customer_id = dc.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, fsm.customer_id), fsm.snapshot_month ), start_cohort AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, arr_usd AS start_arr FROM monthly WHERE snapshot_month = DATE '2025-01-01' AND arr_usd > 0 ), monthly_cohort AS ( SELECT sc.economic_customer_id, m.snapshot_month, COALESCE(m.arr_usd,0) AS arr_usd, sc.start_arr, LAG(COALESCE(m.arr_usd,0),1,sc.start_arr) OVER (PARTITION BY sc.economic_customer_id ORDER BY m.snapshot_month) AS prev_arr FROM start_cohort sc LEFT JOIN monthly m ON sc.economic_customer_id = m.economic_customer_id AND m.snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' ), movement AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, snapshot_month, start_arr, arr_usd, prev_arr, CASE WHEN arr_usd > prev_arr AND prev_arr > 0 THEN arr_usd - prev_arr ELSE 0 END AS expansion_arr, CASE WHEN arr_usd < prev_arr AND arr_usd > 0 THEN prev_arr - arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS contraction_arr, CASE WHEN arr_usd = 0 AND prev_arr > 0 THEN prev_arr ELSE 0 END AS churned_arr, CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 AND prev_arr = 0 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS reactivation_arr FROM monthly_cohort ), agg AS ( SELECT SUM(DISTINCT start_arr) AS bad_test FROM start_cohort ), final AS ( SELECT (SELECT SUM(start_arr) FROM start_cohort) AS starting_arr, SUM(expansion_arr) AS expansion_arr, SUM(contraction_arr) AS contraction_arr, SUM(churned_arr) AS churned_arr, SUM(reactivation_arr) AS reactivation_arr FROM movement ) SELECT starting_arr, expansion_arr, contraction_arr, churned_arr, reactivation_arr, ROUND((starting_arr + expansion_arr + reactivation_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr) / starting_arr * 100, 4) AS nrr_pct, ROUND((starting_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr + reactivation_arr) / starting_arr * 100, 4) AS grr_with_reactivation_pct, ROUND((starting_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr) / starting_arr * 100, 4) AS grr_without_reactivation_pct FROM final
metric_evidence.methodology: Calculated NRR and GRR from monthly starting-cohort ARR movement, separately quantifying reactivation treatment.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_base AS ( SELECT YEAR(fi.invoice_date) AS fiscal_year, fil.line_amount_usd, fil.revenue_type, fil.service_period_start, fil.service_period_end, dp.delivery_model, dp.product_family FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 ) SELECT fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(line_amount_usd),2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100,4) AS management_tagged_recurring_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%recurr%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS restated_recurring_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%recurr%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100,4) AS restated_recurring_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%recurr%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL) THEN line_amount_usd WHEN NOT (LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscription%') AND ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%recurr%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL) THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS reclassified_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type IS NULL AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscription%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(product_family,'')) LIKE '%recurr%') AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL) THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM revenue_base GROUP BY fiscal_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Compared management recurring tags with an independent recurring-support test using product attributes and service periods.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT revenue_type, COUNT(*) AS line_count, ROUND(SUM(line_amount_usd),2) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY revenue_type ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC
metric_evidence.methodology: Profiled management revenue-type tagging used in recurring revenue analysis.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT dp.delivery_model, dp.product_family, COUNT(*) AS line_count, ROUND(SUM(fil.line_amount_usd),2) AS revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY dp.delivery_model, dp.product_family ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 20
metric_evidence.methodology: Assessed delivery-model and product-family evidence supporting recurring restatement.

metric_evidence.query: WITH invoice_base AS ( SELECT fi.invoice_id, fi.invoice_amount_usd, fc.payment_date, fc.amount_paid_usd, fc.days_outstanding FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 ), paid AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_paid_usd * days_outstanding) / SUM(amount_paid_usd), 4) AS weighted_collection_days FROM invoice_base WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd IS NOT NULL ), unpaid AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS unpaid_invoice_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_id) AS unpaid_invoice_count FROM invoice_base WHERE payment_date IS NULL OR amount_paid_usd IS NULL ) SELECT p.weighted_collection_days, u.unpaid_invoice_amount, u.unpaid_invoice_count FROM paid p CROSS JOIN unpaid u
metric_evidence.methodology: Calculated value-weighted collection days for paid FY2025 invoices and separately disclosed unpaid invoices; did not impute traditional DSO.

metric_evidence.query: WITH invoice_status AS ( SELECT fi.invoice_id, fi.customer_id, fi.invoice_date, fi.invoice_amount_usd, COALESCE(MAX(fc.payment_date), NULL) AS payment_date, DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', fi.invoice_date) AS age_days, fi.invoice_amount_usd - COALESCE(SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd),0) AS outstanding_amount FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE fi.invoice_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fi.invoice_id, fi.customer_id, fi.invoice_date, fi.invoice_amount_usd ) SELECT CASE WHEN age_days <= 30 THEN 'current_0_30' WHEN age_days <= 60 THEN '31_60' WHEN age_days <= 90 THEN '61_90' ELSE '90_plus' END AS aging_bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN outstanding_amount > 0 THEN outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS outstanding_amount_usd FROM invoice_status WHERE outstanding_amount > 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN age_days <= 30 THEN 'current_0_30' WHEN age_days <= 60 THEN '31_60' WHEN age_days <= 90 THEN '61_90' ELSE '90_plus' END ORDER BY aging_bucket
metric_evidence.methodology: Constructed invoice-level outstanding balances as of 2025-12-31 and bucketed them by invoice age because explicit due-date fields were unavailable.

metric_evidence.query: WITH revenue_2025 AS ( SELECT COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id) AS economic_customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd, MIN(dc.first_order_date) AS first_order_date FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.parent_customer_id, dc.customer_id) ), ranked AS ( SELECT economic_customer_id, revenue_usd, first_order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC, economic_customer_id) AS rn FROM revenue_2025 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_count, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25),4) AS average_tenure_years FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10
metric_evidence.methodology: Ranked FY2025 economic customers by revenue and averaged tenure from first_order_date through 2025-12-31.

issues: fact_collection has 96 rows with null payment_date, affecting paid-invoice collection timing coverage.
dim_customer parent_customer_id is null for 213 of 214 rows, limiting parent-level consolidation impact.

fact_invoice_line service periods extend to 2026-10-31 while invoice dates end in 2025, so service-period evidence was used only for recurring-support classification rather than revenue-period reassignment.

Traditional period-end DSO is not supported because structured data does not provide an explicit period-end AR balance or due-date-based receivables ledger separate from invoice/collection timing data.

unsupported_metrics: dso_days: traditional DSO not supported by available structured data; only weighted_collection_days could be calculated reliably.
